---
title: "`r params$ticker` Price Report"
output: html_document
params:
  ticker: "TICKER"
  ticker_data: NULL
  sector_name: "Sector"
  n_sector_stocks: 0
  valuation_data: NULL
  valuation_metric_name: "P/E"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set_ggplot_theme()
```

## Cumulative Return

```{r return-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_cumulative_return(
  params$ticker_data,
  params$ticker,
  sector_name = params$sector_name
)
```

## Drawdown from Highs

```{r drawdown-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_drawdown(params$ticker_data, params$ticker) %>%
  add_data_callout(label_fn = scales::percent)
```

## Valuation

```{r valuation-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_valuation_ratio(
  params$valuation_data,
  params$ticker,
  metric_name = params$valuation_metric_name,
  sector_name = params$sector_name
)
```
